rationale: A legitimate functional-form test (conjunctive triple product versus the archive's compensatory SUMRANK) with a clear diagnostic motivation, though it is a close relative of Knowledge Stock Backed Profits and the triple rank product compresses discrimination, so the likely outcome is a firmer slope at the cost of the R&D-driven alpha.

Because act is typically several times dlc, NEG((dlc-act)/lt) is numerically dominated by act/lt and is therefore close to the working-capital-to-liabilities leg already tested in Working Capital Backed Profitability and Net Liquid Position After Debt, so the stated "net rollover pressure" interpretation does not match what the expression actually ranks.

The five-year R&D stock and the five-year minimum R&D/sales are both monotone functions of sustained research intensity and will rank firms very similarly, so nesting them mainly halves the effective weight on the profitability leg rather than adding a separable "continuity" dimension; the divergence in parent slope/alpha statistics is weak evidence of low correlation.

A clean one-change test on Self Financed Knowledge Capital with a coherent owner-financed-moat story, but xrd now enters both legs (current spend in the numerator, five-year sum in the quality leg), so part of the "interaction" is a mechanical R&D-squared term rather than a genuine profitability-times-safety conjunction.

The stated repair does not follow from the expression: the tie mass at zero comes overwhelmingly from COALESCE-zeroed non-reporters, whose three-year minimum is still exactly zero, so shortening the window is a cosmetic parameter tweak on the best-alpha archive signal rather than a fix to the degeneracy it claims to address.

Structurally distinct from the archive's pure rank products — it preserves the profitability main effect and applies the conditional premium to knowledge capital rather than to profitability, which is a real content change over Profitability Plus Safe Firm Premium — with the caveat that all rollover-dependent firms tie at zero in the bonus channel.
